'''Patricia Sheen Cortavarria''' ([[Huánuco|Huanuco]], 1971) is a Peruvian [[biologist]], a Peruvian biologist who serves as the coordinator of the [[Infectious diseases (medical specialty)|Infectious Diseases]] Research Laboratory and co-leader of the Molecular Biology and Bioinformatics Laboratory at the [[Cayetano Heredia University]].<ref name=":0">{{cite news |date=20 March 2020 |title=Científicas peruanas: Patricia Sheen y la lucha frontal contra la TBC en el Perú |url=https://elcomercio.pe/eldominical/ciencia/cientificas-peruanas-patricia-sheen-y-la-lucha-frontal-contra-la-tbc-en-el-peru-tuberculosis-noticia/?ref=ecr |work=El Comercio |language=es-PE}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-03-08 |title=Día Internacional de la Mujer: Científicas UPCH que destacan en sus profesiones |url=https://ciencias.cayetano.edu.pe/noticias/dia-internacional-de-la-mujer-cientificas-upch-que-destacan-en-sus-profesiones/ |access-date=2025-07-30 |website=Facultad de Ciencias e Ingeniería |language=es}}</ref> She has been recognized with the title of "Distinguished Researcher" by the National Council of Science, Technology, and Innovation (CONCYTEC) of Peru for her contributions to the scientific field.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Ficha RENACYT |url=https://servicio-renacyt.concytec.gob.pe/ficha-renacyt/ |access-date=2025-07-30 |website=Plataforma de servicio Renacyt |language=es}}</ref>

Her research primarily focuses on the genetic study of bacteria responsible for [[tuberculosis]],<ref name=":4">{{Cite journal |last1=Sheen |first1=Patricia |last2=Couvin |first2=David |last3=Grandjean |first3=Louis |last4=Zimic |first4=Mirko |last5=Dominguez |first5=Maria |last6=Luna |first6=Giannina |last7=Gilman |first7=Robert H. |last8=Rastogi |first8=Nalin |last9=Moore |first9=David A. == Early life and education ==
Patricia Sheen Cortavarría was born in Huánuco, Peru. From an early age, she demonstrated a profound interest in the study of living organisms, with particular fascination for those examined through the lens of [[microbiology]].<ref>{{Cite book |last=Concytec |url=https://hdl.handle.net/20.500.12390/2259 |title=Científicas del Perú: 24 historias por descubrir |publisher=Consejo Nacional de Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación Tecnológica - Concytec |year=2021 |hdl=20.500.12390/2259 |isbn=978-9972-50-198-2 |language=es |trans-title=Women Scientists of Peru: 24 Stories to Discover}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Correo |first=Redacción |date=2015-01-07 |title=Patricia Sheen: "Queremos más pacientes curados" |url=https://diariocorreo.pe/economia/queremos-mas-pacientes-curados-555733/ |access-date=2025-07-30 |website=Correo |language=es}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |date=6 April 2018 |title=Con Ciencia: Microbiología en Tuberculosis con Dra. Patricia Sheen Cortavarria |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wrXSKogmogM |publisher=Facultad de Ciencias Biológicas - URP}}</ref>

She studied Biology at [[Ricardo Palma University]], where she completed her undergraduate thesis titled ''Identification of [[Lacticaseibacillus casei|Lactobacillus casei]] sp. strain GG in feces using immunological assays''.<ref>{{Cite book |last=URP |url=https://www.urp.edu.pe/pdf/id/2002/n/compendio.pdf |title=Catálogo de resúmenes de tesis de la Facultad de Ciencias Biológicas (1992 - 2014) |publisher=Universidad Ricardo Palma |year=2015 |page=103 |language=es}}</ref>  Building on this foundation, she pursued a Master's degree in Biochemistry at the Universidad Peruana Cayetano Heredia. Subsequently, she earned a Doctorate in Disease Control from [[Johns Hopkins University]] in 2008.<ref name=":1" /><ref>{{Cite web |last=Correo |first=Redacción |date=2014-10-07 |title=Conoce a Patricia Sheen Cortavarría, ganadora del Premio Nacional por la Mujer en la Ciencia 2014 |url=https://diariocorreo.pe/peru/conoce-a-patricia-sheen-cortavarria-ganador-1486/ |access-date=2025-07-30 |website=Correo |language=es}}</ref><ref name=":2">{{Cite web |last=Powder |first=Jackie |date=January 23, 2012 |title=Diagnosing TB on the Cheap |url=https://magazine.publichealth.jhu.edu/2012/diagnosing-tb-on-the-cheap |access-date=2025-04-16 |website=Hopkins Bloomberg Public Health magazine |language=en}}</ref>

== Career ==
Sheen began her scientific career as a research associate in the Microbiology Division of the Prisma Non-Profit Association. A few years later, she undertook residencies at two prominent research institutions. The first was at [[Johns Hopkins University]], where she specialized in genetic techniques ([[Restriction fragment length polymorphism|RFLP]], SSCP) for the [[diagnosis]] of tuberculosis and in the study of [[Gene|genes]] associated with [[isoniazid]] resistance. Subsequently, she joined the Naval Medical Research Unit Detachment (NAMRID) of the United States Navy, where she focused on microbiological diagnostic techniques and research involving ''[[Campylobacter jejuni]]''.<ref name=":3">{{Cite web |last=Concytec |title="Ficha CTI Vitae Sheen Cortavarría Patricia" |url=https://ctivitae.concytec.gob.pe/appDirectorioCTI/VerDatosInvestigador.do?id_investigador=2025}}</ref>

In 1996, Sheen joined the Tuberculosis Division of the Department of Pathology at the [[Cayetano Heredia University]] as a research associate, and in 2001, she assumed the role of Coordinator of the Infectious Diseases Research Laboratory within the Research and Development Laboratories, while also taking on teaching responsibilities at the same institution.<ref name=":3" />

She has led multiple research projects funded by the Peruvian government through CONCYTEC, as well as by international organizations. These include: the diagnosis of pulmonary and pleural tuberculosis via [[Polymerase chain reaction|PCR]] in stool and pleural fluid samples; development of software for the diagnosis of intestinal parasites; implementation of an expert web-based system to support the diagnosis of infectious diseases;<ref name=":2" /> and evaluation of pyrazinamide resistance in ''Mycobacterium tuberculosis''.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Investigación peruana sobre tuberculosis multidrogoresistente gana financiamiento del renombrado ICGEB |url=https://www.gob.pe/institucion/concytec/noticias/696216-investigacion-peruana-sobre-tuberculosis-multidrogoresistente-gana-financiamiento-del-renombrado-icgeb |access-date=2025-07-30 |website=www.gob.pe |language=es-pe}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-02-07 |title=Investigación peruana sobre tuberculosis multidrogoresistente gana financiamiento del renombrado ICGEB |url=https://diariobusinessnews.com/internacional/investigacion-peruana-sobre-tuberculosis-multidrogoresistente-gana-financiamiento-del-renombrado-icgeb/ |access-date=2025-07-30 |website=Diario Business News |language=es}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=RedacciónRPP |date=2023-02-23 |title=¡Orgullo peruano! Investigación sobre tuberculosis gana financiamiento en programa internacional |url=https://rpp.pe/campanas/valor-compartido/orgullo-peruano-investigacion-sobre-tuberculosis-gana-financiamiento-en-programa-internacional-noticia-1468033 |access-date=2025-07-30 |website=rpp.pe |language=es}}</ref>

== Scientific research ==
[[File:PATRICIA SHEEN CORTAVARRIA (1).jpg|thumb|Dr. Patricia Sheen Cortavarría in her laboratory located at the Universidad Peruana Cayetano Heredia]]
Patricia Sheen has more than 70 scientific articles.,<ref name=":1" /> 64 of them in the [[Scopus]] repository.<ref name=":0" /> Some of the most relevant are:

In 1995, she published a short report in [[American Society of Tropical Medicine and Hygiene|The American Journal of Tropical Medicine and Hygiene]] with the name "A Placebo-Controlled Study of Lactobacillus GG Colonization in One-to-Three-Year-Old Peruvian Children"''.''<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Sheen |first1=Patricia |last2=Oberhelman |first2=Richard A. |last3=Gilman |first3=Robert H. |last4=Cabrera |first4=Lilly |last5=Verastegui |first5=Manuela |last6=Madico |first6=Guillermo |title=Short Report: A Placebo-Controlled Study of Lactobacillus GG Colonization in One-to-Three-Year-Old Peruvian Children |journal=The American Journal of Tropical Medicine and Hygiene |date=1 May 1995 |volume=52 |issue=5 |pages=389–392 |doi=10.4269/ajtmh.1995.52.389 |pmid=7771602 }}</ref> In 1998, her first scientific article about [[Mycobacterium tuberculosis]] was about its detection in nasopharyngeal aspirate samples in children.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Franchi |first1=Luis Miguel |last2=Cama |first2=Rosa I. |last3=Gilman |first3=Robert H. |last4=Montenegro-James |first4=Sonia |last5=Sheen |first5=Patricia |title=Detection of Myobacterium tuberculosis in nasopharyngeal aspirate samples in children |journal=The Lancet |date=21 November 1998 |volume=352 |issue=9141 |pages=1681–1682 |doi=10.1016/s0140-6736(05)61454-7|doi-access=free |pmid=9853450 }}</ref>

In 2013, she published findings on the [[genetic diversity]] of ''Mycobacterium tuberculosis'' [[Strain (biology)|strains]] present in Peru and their relationship with drug resistance.<ref name=":4" /> They also reported factors associated with resistance to pyrazinamide in ''M. tuberculosis'', focusing on the expression of the ''pncA'' gene, [[pyrazinamidase]] enzyme activity, and the expulsion of [[pyrazinoic acid]].<ref name=":5" /> Later, in 2017, they presented a comprehensive genomic analysis of 68 ''M. tuberculosis'' strains isolated from patients in Peru, identifying [[Mutation|mutations]] and genes linked to resistance to pyrazinamide, a key drug in tuberculosis treatment.<ref name=":6" />

In 2019, Sheen proposed an automated system for tuberculosis diagnosis using digital image analysis based on the Drug Susceptibility Testing by Microscopic Observation method, known as [[Microscopic Observation Drug Susceptibility assay|MODS]].<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Lopez-Garnier |first1=Santiago |last2=Sheen |first2=Patricia |last3=Zimic |first3=Mirko |date=2019-02-27 |title=Automatic diagnostics of tuberculosis using convolutional neural networks analysis of MODS digital images |journal=[[PLOS ONE]] |language=en |volume=14 |issue=2 |article-number=e0212094 |doi=10.1371/journal.pone.0212094 |doi-access=free |issn=1932-6203 |pmc=6392246 |pmid=30811445 |bibcode=2019PLoSO..1412094L }}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Caviedes |first1=L. |last2=Lee |first2=T. S. |last3=Gilman |first3=R. H. |last4=Sheen |first4=P. |last5=Spellman |first5=E. |last6=Lee |first6=E. H. |last7=Berg |first7=D. E. |last8=Montenegro-James |first8=S. |year=2000 |title=Rapid, efficient detection and drug susceptibility testing of Mycobacterium tuberculosis in sputum by microscopic observation of broth cultures. The Tuberculosis Working Group in Peru |journal=[[Journal of Clinical Microbiology]] |volume=38 |issue=3 |pages=1203–1208 |doi=10.1128/JCM.38.3.1203-1208.2000 |issn=0095-1137 |pmc=86377 |pmid=10699023}}</ref> In 2022, she published results on the evaluation of alternative [[growth medium]] designed to reduce the cost of MODS-based tuberculosis diagnosis.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Sheen |first1=Patricia |last2=Rodriguez |first2=Joseline |last3=Alcántara |first3=Roberto |last4=Vargas |first4=Johnny |last5=Grandjean |first5=Louis |last6=Moore |first6=David A.J. |last7=Gilman |first7=Robert H. |last8=Zimic |first8=Mirko |date=July 2022 |title=Alternative cost-effective media to facilitate MODS culture for diagnostics of tuberculosis |url=https://discovery.ucl.ac.uk/id/eprint/10152588/ |journal=Tuberculosis |volume=135 |article-number=102225 |doi=10.1016/j.tube.2022.102225 |pmid=35728429 |hdl=10757/668988 |hdl-access=free}}</ref> That same year, she introduced a device for the automatic decontamination, purification, and concentration of sputum samples, aimed at lowering the costs of diagnosing tuberculosis and multidrug-resistant tuberculosis. The invention received a Gold Medal at the "Korea International Women's Invention Exposition – KIWIE 2023" and a special commendation from Dongguk University.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-10-12 |title=Inventoras de Cayetano Heredia logran medallas de oro y bronce en Kiwie 2023 |url=https://investigacion.cayetano.edu.pe/noticias/inventoras-de-cayetano-heredia-logran-medallas-de-oro-y-bronce-en-kiwie-2023/ |access-date=2025-07-30 |website=Investigación |language=es}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-08-10 |title=Investigadores de Cayetano ganan medallas y reconocimiento especial en feria de inventos de Corea del Sur |url=https://ciencias.cayetano.edu.pe/noticias/investigadores-de-cayetano-ganan-medallas-y-reconocimiento-especial-en-feria-de-inventos-de-corea-del-sur/ |access-date=2025-07-30 |website=Facultad de Ciencias e Ingeniería |language=es}}</ref>

In 2023, she proposed a nuclear magnetic resonance method to determine pyrazinamide susceptibility directly in the supernatant of [[Sputum culture|sputum cultures]] collected from tuberculosis patients. Comparative analyses against other biochemical and molecular assays suggest that the newly developed method could become the next "[[Gold standard (test)|gold standard]]" for determining susceptibility to this drug.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Lopez |first1=Juan M. |last2=Zimic |first2=Mirko |last3=Vallejos |first3=Katherine |last4=Sevilla |first4=Diego |last5=Quispe-Carbajal |first5=Mariella |last6=Roncal |first6=Elisa |last7=Rodríguez |first7=Joseline |last8=Rodríguez |first8=Jhojailith |last9=Antiparra |first9=Ricardo |last10=Arteaga |first10=Héctor |last11=Gilman |first11=Robert H. |last12=Maruenda |first12=Helena |last13=Sheen |first13=Patricia |date=18 April 2023 |title=Quantitative 1H Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Assay for the Rapid Detection of Pyrazinamide Resistance in Mycobacterium tuberculosis from Sputum Samples |journal=Journal of Clinical Microbiology |volume=61 |issue=5 |pages=e01522–22 |doi=10.1128/jcm.01522-22 |pmc=10204627 |pmid=37071032}}</ref>

== Awards and recognitions ==

Patricia Sheen received the National L'Oréal-Unesco-Concytec Award for Women in Science 2014 presenting the "Determination of Pyrazinamide Resistance Using Quantitative [[Wayne Method]] in Mycobacterium tuberculosis (TB) Strains.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Investigadora peruana gana premio internacional sobre lucha contra la tuberculosis |url=https://www.gob.pe/institucion/minsa/noticias/31186-investigadora-peruana-gana-premio-internacional-sobre-lucha-contra-la-tuberculosis |access-date=2025-02-27 |website=www.gob.pe |language=es-pe}}</ref>

In 2021, her life and research story has appeared and also other female scientist stories in the [[Concytec]] book titled ''Scientists of Peru: 24 stories to discover'' (Científicas del Perú: 24 historias por descubrir, in Spanish).<ref>{{cite news |last1=EDITORA PERÚ Empresa Peruana de Servicios Editoriales S. A. |date=19 March 2021 |title=Científicas del Perú: lanzan libro con 24 historias de mujeres dedicadas a la ciencia |url=https://andina.pe/agencia/noticia-cientificas-del-peru-lanzan-libro-24-historias-mujeres-dedicadas-a-ciencia-838101.aspx |work=andina.pe |language=es}}</ref>

In 2023, Sheen obtained a gold medal and a special recognition with PhD Mirko Zimic, for their invention "Automatic equipment for the decontamination, purification and concentration of sputum for a cost-effective diagnosis of tuberculosis and multidrug resistance" in the 16th International Exhibition of Women's Inventions in South Korea, "KIWIE" 2023, took place in Seoul from July 20 to 22.<ref>{{cite news |title=Inventoras de Cayetano Heredia logran medallas de oro y bronce en Kiwie 2023 |url=https://investigacion.cayetano.edu.pe/noticias/inventoras-de-cayetano-heredia-logran-medallas-de-oro-y-bronce-en-kiwie-2023/ |work=Investigación |date=12 October 2023 |language=es}}</ref>
